intro: Finland is a parliamentary republic and, since 2023, a member of NATO.

chapters.title: President and parliament
text: The president is directly elected for six years and leads foreign policy; Alexander Stubb was elected in 2024. The single-chamber parliament, the Eduskunta, has 200 members and chooses the prime minister.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag is a blue cross on white, said to represent lakes and snow. Finland is the only Nordic country that uses the euro.
